judgments.rationale: Proposal P0000 correctly incorporates the governing conditions from referenced clause (ii) into an independently usable summary and scope for claim C0001, faithfully reflecting the requirement that the plan was in effect for a plan year beginning in 2007 and maintained a positive funding standard account balance under section 1082(b) as of the end of that plan year.

Proposal P0001 is unsupported because its summary states that the plan must be in effect for a plan year beginning in 2008, which directly contradicts passage F008 requiring the plan year to begin in 2007.

source_spans.quote: In the case of a single-employer plan described in clause (ii), the plan sponsor may elect to maintain a funding standard carryover balance, until such balance is reduced to zero.

(ii) Plans maintaining funding standard account in 2007 A plan is described in this clause if the plan—

(I) was in effect for a plan year beginning in 2007, and

(II) had a positive balance in the funding standard account under section 1082(b) of this title as in effect for such plan year and determined as of the end of such plan year.
